fixed_candidate.name: AUXILIARY_FREE_CNF_EXISTENTIAL_PROJECTION
fixed_candidate.contract: Given a polynomial-size width<=3 CNF F(X,Y), output a CNF G(X) with no fresh variables such that G(X) is logically equivalent to exists Y F(X,Y).

polynomial_3cnf_source_family.name: PARITY_CHAIN_3CNF
polynomial_3cnf_source_family.auxiliary_variables: z_2,...,z_n plus final unit-enforcement auxiliaries p,q

clauses: (not a OR not b OR not z)

polynomial_3cnf_source_family.chain: z_2=x_1 XOR x_2; z_i=z_{i-1} XOR x_i for i=3,...,n
even_parity_enforcement: (not z_n OR p OR not q)
(not z_n OR not p OR q)
(not z_n OR not p OR not q)
polynomial_3cnf_source_family.size: O(n) clauses and variables, all clauses of width 3.
polynomial_3cnf_source_family.projection_semantics: Existentially quantifying all auxiliary variables yields the even-parity Boolean function on X.

parity_cnf_lower_bound.theorem: Every auxiliary-free CNF over x_1,...,x_n equivalent to even parity requires at least 2^(n-1) non-tautological clauses.
proof: Let C be any non-tautological clause implied by even parity.

If C omits at least one variable, assign its mentioned variables so that every literal of C is false. At least one variable remains free; choose the free variables so that the full assignment has even parity. This is an even-parity assignment falsifying C, contradiction.
Hence every non-tautological implied clause must mention all n variables.
A full-width non-tautological clause is falsified by exactly one total assignment.
An exact CNF for even parity must reject every one of the 2^(n-1) odd-parity assignments, so at least 2^(n-1) full-width clauses are required.

derived_TRUMP_barrier.claim: A universal selector-free projection architecture that insists on an equivalent auxiliary-free CNF over the surviving semantic variables cannot maintain polynomial live state.
derived_TRUMP_barrier.reason: The O(n)-size 3CNF parity-chain family projects to even parity, whose auxiliary-free CNF representation is exponential.

next_admissible_math.question: Can one use a richer but polynomial-size state with auxiliary variables while proving that the auxiliaries encode genuinely compressed projected semantics rather than merely reifying eliminated branch choices, and still preserve strict global descent?
